title: LOT study definition (base + delta)
description: Closed schema for a study. Structural rules only; cross-rules (single base, no inheritance cycles, override-references-inherited-only, add-not-duplicating-inherited, not-both-disabled-and-overridden, gate-DAG-satisfiable, params-conform-to-gate-module-schema) are enforced by the runtime study validator, not expressible in plain JSON Schema.

version.description: semantic version of this study definition

base.description: the study this one derives from; null for a base study (e.g. overall). Pinned by version + hash so a reproducibility run never resolves a mutable base dynamically.

approval.description: machine-readable clinical sign-off (validate_study.R). 'approved' requires an auditable signer + ISO date; a release run (--require-approved) blocks any 'draft' in the inheritance chain.

parameters.description: algorithm parameter overrides (induction windows, MAP discon gap, SCT/CART windows, MAX_LOT, ...). Validated against the parameter spec by the typed-config validator.

reference_data.description: per-codelist lock: id -> {version, hash} of the approved snapshot this study pins.

gates.description: the gate delta applied on top of `base`.

add.description: NEW gates not present in the base

override.description: EXISTING (inherited) gates whose parameters or pinned version changed

gateMap.description: gate name (optionally name@version) -> true | parameter object
